name: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets
summary: Discount shopping center featuring housewares, apparel, accessories & footwear stores, plus dining.
demographics: The center primarily attracts middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, with a strong presence of visitors aged 25-54 seeking brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. The trade area draws from Grand Prairie's diverse suburban population as well as shoppers from neighboring communities including Arlington, Irving, and Dallas, representing a mix of household types from young families to empty nesters. Typical visitors are deal-oriented consumers who prefer the outlet shopping experience and are willing to travel to the center's convenient Interstate 20 location for significant savings on national brands.
description: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets is a premier shopping destination located conveniently along West Interstate 20 in Grand Prairie, Texas, offering exceptional value on top brand names. As part of the renowned Premium Outlets collection operated by Simon Property Group, this outdoor shopping center features designer and brand-name outlet stores where shoppers can find significant savings of 25% to 65% off retail prices every day. The center attracts bargain-savvy shoppers from across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex seeking deals on fashion, footwear, accessories, home goods, and more from their favorite national and international brands. With its accessible location near major highways and ample parking, Grand Prairie Premium Outlets provides a convenient and enjoyable outlet shopping experience for both local residents and visitors to the region. The open-air layout allows guests to browse from store to store while enjoying the Texas weather, making it a popular destination for day trips and weekend shopping excursions.
